items.summary_zh: 活细胞单分子荧光成像显示，大肠杆菌 DNA gyrase 的 GyrA/GyrB 可形成富含 GyrB 的液态凝聚体，并提出其提高酶过程性的机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以定量活细胞成像、FRAP 和结构 docking 解释体内 gyrase 活性为何可超过体外速率估计，为细菌 DNA 拓扑调控补充了凝聚体机制。
items.abstract_zh: IIA 型细菌 topoisomerase DNA gyrase 是一个 GyrA/GyrB heterotetramer，通过引入负 supercoils 来松弛正 DNA supercoils，在维持转录和 DNA 复制中发挥关键作用。然而，体外 gyrase 催化 supercoiling 的速率无法解释体内所需的高得多的速率。为解决这一难题，我们在活 Escherichia coli 中使用 GyrA/GyrB reporters 进行高速单分子荧光成像，结果显示细胞中表达的 GyrB 比 GyrA 多 [~]40%，其存在于弥散 pool 或 clusters 中，clusters 的移动性取决于它们是否与 DNA 结合。出乎意料的是，我们发现 clusters 是非化学计量的，所含 GyrB 比 GyrA 多 [~]150%，显著高于细胞平均值；fluorescence recovery after photobleaching 显示 clustered GyrA 和 GyrB 的行为如同液体，且可通过施加靶向 gyrase 的抗生素增加其丰度。结构 docking 表明，液态由过量 GyrB 通过弱的多价相互作用逐步结合到已有 clusters 而稳定。通过在液态凝聚体中运行，从 DNA 解离的 A2B2 能够快速重新结合而非扩散离去，从而增加酶的过程性，使其可进行多轮催化并跟上体内转录和 DNA 复制。这表明凝聚体具有克服扩散造成的动力学限制的新作用。
items.author_line: Syeda, A. H., Hollands, K., Frame, L., Shepherd, J., Payne-Dwyer, A., Goffee, E., Burton, N., Basu, A., Noy, A., Maxwell, A., Leake, M. C.

items.title: A contextualised protein language model reveals the functional syntax of bacterial evolution
items.abstract_or_text: Bacteria have evolved a vast diversity of functions and behaviours that are currently incompletely understood and poorly predicted from DNA sequence alone. To understand the syntax of bacterial evolution and discover genome-to-phenotype relationships, we curated over 1.3 million genomes spanning bacterial phylogenetic space, represented each as an ordered sequence of proteins, and used these sequences to train a transformer-based, contextualised protein language model, Bacformer. By pretraining on genome-wide evolutionary patterns, Bacformer captures the compositional and positional relationships of proteins and thereby provides a whole-genome framework for linking genomic organisation and content to measurable bacterial traits. We demonstrate the ability of Bacformer to accurately predict protein-protein interactions; uncover operon structure, which we validated experimentally; infer important phenotypic traits, including antimicrobial resistance, while revealing likely causal genes; and design template synthetic proteomes with desirable properties. Thus, Bacformer establishes a genomic foundation model that reveals the evolutionary rules governing bacterial gene organisation, function, and phenotype, opening a route to systematic whole-genome engineering.
items.summary_zh: Bacformer 在逾 130 万个细菌基因组的有序蛋白序列上训练，以全基因组语境预测蛋白互作、operon、表型和合成蛋白组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模覆盖广泛细菌系统发育空间，并包含对 operon 推断的实验验证；文中关于 AMR 与候选因果基因的结论仍应按其模型和验证范围解读。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌已经演化出大量目前尚未被充分理解、也难以仅凭 DNA 序列预测的功能和行为。为理解细菌进化的语法并发现基因组到表型的关系，我们整理了跨越细菌系统发育空间的逾 130 万个基因组，将每个基因组表示为有序的蛋白序列，并使用这些序列训练了一个基于 transformer 的、语境化 protein language model——Bacformer。通过在全基因组进化模式上预训练，Bacformer 捕捉蛋白的组成和位置关系，因而提供了将基因组组织与内容同可测量细菌性状联系起来的全基因组框架。我们展示了其准确预测 protein-protein interactions 的能力；它发现了我们通过实验验证的 operon 结构；能够推断包括 antimicrobial resistance 在内的重要表型，同时揭示可能的 causal genes；并可设计具有理想性质的模板合成蛋白组。因此，Bacformer 建立了一个基因组基础模型，揭示支配细菌基因组织、功能和表型的进化规则，为系统性全基因组工程开辟了路径。
items.author_line: Wiatrak, M., Abelson, D. C., Mikhaylenko, R., Vinas Torne, R., Ntemourtsidou, M., Dinan, A., Arora, D., Horsfield, S. T., Lees, J., Brbic, M., Weimann, A., Andres Floto, R.

items.title: PerturbLDM: conditional latent diffusion for modelling single-cell perturbation responses
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell perturbation profiling maps intervention-induced phenotypes, yet experiments measure only a fraction of the perturbation-context space. Learning context-dependent perturbation effects could enable response prediction beyond measured conditions. Here we introduce PerturbLDM, a latent-diffusion framework for conditional generation of single-cell transcriptional responses. Following Tahoe-100M pretraining, it predicted 13,942 held-out combinations of observed drugs, doses and cell lines more accurately than existing methods, with higher matched-control effect correlation than an additive marginal baseline in 95.2% of conditions. The Tahoe-100M-pretrained model was further used to rank PANACEA compounds by pathway similarity, placing shared-mechanism pairs among nearest neighbours. In smaller datasets, Per-turbLDM generated a mid-gestational fetal-colon state with 67% lower gene-wise error than Squidiff, retaining the balance between absorptive and BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes. In PBMCs, it captured six of seven interferon and antiviral programmes and the interferon-associated FAO-OXPHOS programme more accurately than scGen. Together, these results support conditional response generation across data scales and biological settings.
items.summary_zh: PerturbLDM 用 Tahoe-100M 预训练的条件 latent diffusion 生成单细胞扰动反应，在多种药物、剂量、细胞系和生物体系中与既有方法比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对 13,942 个留出组合、胎儿结肠和 PBMC 的评估表明其具备跨情境预测潜力；模型生成结果仍需与新实验扰动逐项核实。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞扰动 profiling 绘制干预诱导的表型，但实验仅测量扰动—情境空间的一小部分。学习依赖情境的扰动效应，可能使人们能够预测超出已测量条件的反应。在此，我们提出 PerturbLDM：一个用于条件生成单细胞转录反应的 latent-diffusion 框架。在 Tahoe-100M 预训练后，它对 13,942 个由已观测药物、剂量和细胞系构成的留出组合的预测优于既有方法，并且在 95.2% 的条件下，其 matched-control effect correlation 高于加性边缘基线。经 Tahoe-100M 预训练的模型还用于按通路相似性对 PANACEA compounds 排名，将共享机制的配对置于最近邻之中。在较小数据集中，PerturbLDM 生成的 mid-gestational fetal-colon state 的逐基因误差比 Squidiff 低 67%，同时保留吸收性与 BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes 的平衡。在 PBMC 中，它比 scGen 更准确地捕捉了七个 interferon 和 antiviral programmes 中的六个，以及 interferon-associated FAO-OXPHOS programme。综上，这些结果支持在不同数据规模和生物学情境下开展条件反应生成。
items.author_line: Yu, L., Hsieh, K.-L., Chu, Y., Lan, Q., Zhao, X., Hsu, Y.-C., Wood, C. S., Rasmy, L., Pilie, P. G., Zhi, D., Zhao, Z., Jiang, X., Dai, Y.

items.title: CLEAR-ST: Physics-informed probabilistic decontamination of spatial transcriptomics by modeling mRNA lateral diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics is a rapidly evolving technology that allows for the measurement of gene expression in a spatially resolved manner. However, one technical problem that occurs for many sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms is the presence of mRNA lateral diffusion, where mRNA from one spot can bind to probes in another spot, leading to contamination and inaccurate gene expression measurements. In Visium-like assays, this artifact is often visible as structured out-of-tissue signal and boundary-associated expression halos, yet its magnitude, spatial decay, and directional bias vary substantially across samples. Here, we present CLEAR-ST, a physics-informed probabilistic framework for correcting diffusion-like contamination in spatial transcriptomics data. CLEAR-ST infers a latent clean expression field using a denoising autoencoder and links it to the observed counts through a graph-Laplacian forward contamination model with learnable diffusion parameters, finally evaluated with a selectable count likelihood. We first conducted a comprehensive comparison between 10X official and independently generated Visium samples, demonstrating that out-of-tissue count profiles are highly related to nearby in-tissue expression, more concentrated near tissue boundaries, and diffusion directions across genes are likely coherent. Across real samples with varying contamination burden, CLEAR-ST improved spatial domain recovery, increased gene-level spatial autocorrelation, and enhanced the biological specificity of downstream analyses such as marker gene discovery, pathway identification and cell type deconvolution. Compared to benchmark methods, CLEAR-ST showed consistent gains in clustering quality and concordance with manual annotations. Together, CLEAR-ST provides an interpretable and practical approach for diffusion-aware correction of capture-based spatial transcriptomics data.
items.summary_zh: CLEAR-ST 以 mRNA 横向扩散的图 Laplacian 前向污染模型校正空间转录组污染，并在多种 Visium 样本中评估下游改善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把可解释的物理污染假设与概率模型结合，并与 10X 官方及独立生成样本和多种基准方法比较，有助于提高空间结果的技术可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学是一项快速发展的技术，可对具有空间分辨率的基因表达进行测量。然而，许多测序型空间转录组平台存在一个技术问题：mRNA 横向扩散，即一个 spot 的 mRNA 与另一 spot 的 probes 结合，导致污染和不准确的基因表达测量。在 Visium-like assays 中，这一伪影常表现为组织外的结构化信号以及组织交界附近的表达光晕；但其大小、空间衰减和方向偏倚在样本间差异很大。在此，我们提出 CLEAR-ST：一个用于校正空间转录组中扩散样污染的 physics-informed probabilistic framework。CLEAR-ST 使用 denoising autoencoder 推断潜在的清洁表达场，并通过具有可学习扩散参数的 graph-Laplacian forward contamination model 将其与观测 counts 联系起来，最后以可选择的 count likelihood 进行评估。我们首先对 10X 官方和独立生成的 Visium 样本进行了全面比较，结果显示组织外 count profiles 与附近组织内表达高度相关，在组织交界附近更集中，并且各基因的扩散方向可能一致。在污染负荷不同的真实样本中，CLEAR-ST 改善了空间 domain recovery，增加了基因层面的空间自相关，并增强 marker gene discovery、pathway identification 和 cell type deconvolution 等下游分析的生物学特异性。与基准方法相比，CLEAR-ST 在聚类质量和与人工注释的一致性方面获得稳定提升。综上，CLEAR-ST 为 capture-based spatial transcriptomics data 提供了一种可解释且实用的、具扩散感知能力的校正方法。
items.author_line: Ma, K., Huang, Y., Ho, J. W. K.

items.title: RegFM: an interpretable context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation
items.abstract_or_text: Transcriptional regulation is governed by interactions between cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and trans-acting regulators in a context-specific manner. Although DNA and single-cell foundation models have enabled modeling regulatory biology at scale, most represent either sequence or cellular state alone, limiting their ability to capture context-dependent gene regulation. Here we present RegFM, a context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation. RegFM treats transcriptional regulation as a dialogue between cis-regulatory sequences (e.g., CREs) and trans-acting regulators (e.g., transcription factors (TFs) and chromatin regulators (CRs)) by coupling long-range CRE representations with TFs and CRs activity. Trained on large-scale ENCODE and CELLxGENE transcriptomic profiles, RegFM learns gene-centered regulatory representations that generalize across unseen cellular contexts. In a wide range of tasks, including gene expression prediction, cis-regulatory element annotation, bivalent promoter and dosage-sensitivity classification, and perturbation-response prediction, RegFM consistently improves over existing methods. RegFM emerges as a scalable and interpretable framework for modeling human transcriptional regulation and provides insights into context-dependent gene regulatory programs.
items.summary_zh: RegFM 将远程 cis-regulatory elements 表征与 TF、chromatin regulators 活性结合，以语境感知方式建模人类转录调控。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型同时涵盖序列与细胞状态，并在表达预测、CRE 注释、双价启动子、剂量敏感性和扰动反应等任务中评测，为可解释调控建模提供统一思路。
items.abstract_zh: 转录调控由 cis-regulatory elements（CREs）与 trans-acting regulators 在特定语境中的相互作用支配。尽管 DNA 和单细胞基础模型已经能够大规模建模调控生物学，多数模型只表征序列或细胞状态之一，限制了其捕捉依赖语境的基因调控的能力。在此，我们提出用于人类转录调控的语境感知基础模型 RegFM。RegFM 将转录调控视为 cis-regulatory sequences（如 CREs）与 trans-acting regulators（如 transcription factors（TFs）和 chromatin regulators（CRs））之间的对话：它将远程 CRE 表征与 TF 和 CR 活性耦合。RegFM 在大规模 ENCODE 和 CELLxGENE 转录组谱上训练，学习以基因为中心的调控表征，并可泛化至未见的细胞语境。在包括 gene expression prediction、cis-regulatory element annotation、bivalent promoter 和 dosage-sensitivity classification 以及 perturbation-response prediction 在内的广泛任务中，RegFM 均稳定优于现有方法。RegFM 是一个可扩展且可解释的人类转录调控建模框架，并为理解依赖语境的基因调控程序提供见解。
items.author_line: Gao, Z., Sun, Y., Wang, H., Jiang, R., Liu, Q.

items.title: Phenotype-associated spatial biomarker discovery in spatial transcriptomics with spHOT
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics now profiles patient cohorts at single-cell resolution, enabling analysis of disease-associated cell organization in situ. However, discovering such spatial biomarkers remains challenging because relevant structures occur at unknown scales and cell-or niche-level annotations are rarely available. We present spHOT, a deep learning framework that localizes phenotype-associated spatial biomarkers from sample-level labels. spHOT combines spatial foundation model embeddings, a hierarchical domain tree for multi-resolution tissue representation, and a teacher-student multiple instance learning architecture that converts sample labels into cell-level biomarker scores. In controlled simulations and real-tissue benchmarks, spHOT outperformed existing spatial and single-cell methods in localizing ground-truth biomarkers. Across fibrotic, metabolic, and autoimmune disease datasets, spHOT recovered disease-relevant niches and tissue states reported by supervised analyses in the original studies. Cross-disease application of spHOT transferred biomarkers across chronic lung diseases without retraining. spHOT enables scalable, annotation-efficient spatial biomarker discovery in cohort-scale spatial transcriptomics.
items.summary_zh: spHOT 从样本级表型标签中定位空间生物标志物，结合空间基础模型 embedding、多分辨组织树和 teacher-student multiple instance learning。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对空间队列中常缺少细胞或生态位标签的问题，在模拟、真实组织和跨疾病迁移中进行评测，可支持更高通量的空间标志物发现。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学如今可在单细胞分辨率下对患者队列进行 profiling，使得人们能够原位分析疾病相关的细胞组织方式。然而，发现此类空间生物标志物仍然困难，因为相关结构出现于未知尺度，并且细胞或生态位层面的注释很少可得。我们提出 spHOT：一个从样本级标签定位表型相关空间生物标志物的深度学习框架。spHOT 将 spatial foundation model embeddings、用于多分辨率组织表征的 hierarchical domain tree，以及将样本标签转换为细胞层面生物标志物评分的 teacher-student multiple instance learning architecture 相结合。在受控模拟和真实组织基准中，spHOT 在定位 ground-truth biomarkers 方面优于既有空间和单细胞方法。在纤维化、代谢性和自身免疫疾病数据集中，spHOT 恢复了原始研究中由监督分析报告的疾病相关生态位和组织状态。spHOT 的跨疾病应用可在无需重新训练的情况下，在慢性肺病之间迁移生物标志物。spHOT 使队列尺度空间转录组中的空间生物标志物发现具有可扩展性且对注释要求更低。
items.author_line: Kim, H., Kim, D., Jung, S., Lee, S., Kim, K.

items.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains 175 instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-verified Lean formalizations and proofs. Evaluations of leading LLMs reveal that current models remain far from reliably completing the full research pipeline. In particular, autoformalization is the sharpest bottleneck: the best model achieves only 11.5 on translating natural-language claims into formal theorem statements, compared with 28.6 Pass@8 when proving human-provided formal statements. Building on \ourbenchmark, we further develop an automated TCS research framework that generates, formalizes, filters, and proves new claims. Of 64 generated claims, only 6 ultimately pass expert evaluation and proof verification, indicating that beyond formalization, limited research taste remains another major barrier to autonomous TCS research.
items.summary_zh: FormalTCS 以近期顶会理论计算机科学论文为来源，评测模型从理解定义到 Lean 证明的端到端研究能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将自然语言定理陈述的形式化、形式化陈述证明和专家复核结合起来，显示当前模型在自动形式化环节仍存在显著困难。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化理论计算机科学（TCS）研究方面显示出不断增长的潜力，但现有基准与真实研究情境仍相距甚远。我们提出 \ourbenchmark：一个经专家验证的基准，用于评估 LLM 在前沿、端到端 TCS 研究中的表现。\ourbenchmark 包含 175 个实例，取自 2025—2026 年被 STOC、FOCS、SODA 和 COLT 接收的论文，保留各论文特有的定义、假设和证明依赖关系，并提供经专家核验的 Lean 形式化和证明。对领先 LLM 的评估表明，当前模型距离可靠完成完整研究流程仍很远。尤其是，自动形式化是最突出的瓶颈：最佳模型将自然语言断言翻译成形式化定理陈述时仅达到 11.5，而证明人工提供的形式化陈述时的 Pass@8 为 28.6。基于 \ourbenchmark，我们进一步开发了一个自动化 TCS 研究框架，用于生成、形式化、筛选并证明新的断言。在 64 个生成断言中，最终只有 6 个通过专家评估和证明验证，表明除形式化外，有限的研究品味仍是自主 TCS 研究的另一项主要障碍。
items.author_line: Dingzirui Wang, Xuanliang Zhang, Keyan Xu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che

items.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard that classifies any verification scheme along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration; no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth; correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. Central to VAL is the completeness blind spot: substitution- and sampling-based verifiers can confirm that proposed candidates hold, but cannot prove that no candidate was missed. We further identify a dichotomy the literature has not stated: completeness is reachable only for formally specifiable properties, whereas empirical open-world verification (fact-checking, diagnosis) caps at anchored correctness (L2). We document this gap empirically across four domains (symbolic mathematics, behavior monitoring, medical diagnosis, and code generation, the last a reverse validation with predictions stated before evidence) and in the strongest formal-verification baseline in our survey, whose authors note the verifier focuses on the correctness of each step. We show the levels of granularity, concept hierarchy, risk, and system stack are orthogonal to VAL, resolving a systematic conflation across 17 surveyed papers. Code and full assessment are released as supplementary material.
items.summary_zh: 该文提出 Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL)，按验证规范来源和结论保证程度描述 LLM 推理验证系统。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章清楚区分候选正确性与完备性，并指出可形式化性质和开放世界事实核查所能提供的验证保证不同。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益与验证器配合使用，例如步骤检查器、自一致性筛选器、基于工具的事实检查器和形式化证明助手，这些验证器声称能够发现模型的错误。然而，验证文献中“level”一词至少被用于五种不同含义：验证粒度、概念抽象、风险等级、系统栈层次，以及真值的认识论来源。我们提出 Verification Autonomy Levels（VAL），这一元标准沿单一轴对任何验证方案进行分类：验证规范来自何处，以及判定结果保证什么？VAL 从 L0（LLM 自我声明；没有确定性依据）经由 L2（客观真值；仅保证正确性），延伸至 L3/L4（对单一性质或领域级完备性的可判定系统）；在不受限情形下，L5 不可能实现。VAL 的核心是完备性盲点：基于替换和采样的验证器可以确认已提出候选成立，却无法证明没有遗漏候选。我们进一步发现了文献尚未阐明的一种二分：只有对可形式化描述的性质才能获得完备性，而经验性的开放世界验证（事实检查、诊断）最高只能达到有依据的正确性（L2）。我们在四个领域中以实证方式记录了这一差距：符号数学、行为监测、医学诊断和代码生成；其中代码生成采用反向验证，预测先于证据给出。我们还考察了综述中最强的形式化验证基线，其作者指出验证器聚焦于每一步的正确性。我们表明，粒度、概念层级、风险和系统栈与 VAL 相互正交，从而解决了 17 篇被调查论文中的系统性混淆。代码和完整评估作为补充材料发布。
items.author_line: Yajie Yin

items.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic indeterminacy, arising from incomplete, partial, or expressive preferences, and (ii) structural indeterminacy, arising from the non-existence of solutions under standard social choice concepts. Across a hierarchy of tasks, we show that state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings.
items.summary_zh: 该研究把偏好推理中的不确定性区分为认识论不确定性和结构不确定性，并考察模型能否识别无确定解的实例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将“知道何时无法确定”作为可测的推理能力，报告当前模型即使在验证场景中也常混淆可确定与不可确定实例。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）演变为决策智能体，对偏好的推理能力成为对齐、协调和集体智能的基础。然而，与标准基准不同，现实世界中的偏好推理天然是不确定的：信息可能不完整，且有效解可能不存在。我们认为，不确定性而非仅仅正确性，是 AI 推理的核心挑战。我们沿两个维度形式化这一挑战：(i) 认识论不确定性，源于不完整、部分或表达性偏好；(ii) 结构不确定性，源于标准社会选择概念下解的不存在。我们在一组层次化任务上表明，最先进语言模型系统性地无法区分可确定与不可确定的实例，即使在验证场景中也表现出校准不当的推理。
items.author_line: Hadi Hosseini, Samarth Khanna, Xiyuan Wang

items.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
items.summary_zh: EvoResearcher 在冻结 LLM 上采用生成、自我批评与修订的推理时协议，并用 CONFIRMED 信号提前终止。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究在 BBH、GSM8K 与 MATH 上报告了相同准确率下的较少生成次数，同时明确说明其未在 BBH 上带来可检出的准确率提升。
items.abstract_zh: 推理 LLM 的强化学习训练（例如 GRPO）成本高昂，并且需要可控环境，使每项贡献都必须依赖完整训练流程。我们提出 EvoResearcher，这是一种免训练、推理时协议，在单个冻结 LLM 主干上加入成本受限的自我反思。该协议重复执行生成→自我批评→修订，直到达到最大深度 D，或批评返回 CONFIRMED 哨兵；这是一种隐式提前停止机制，使主干模型能够在严格计算预算下自行验证其答案。四个自反思元奖励组成部分（正确性、效率、反思深度、工具调用多样性）作为设计原则，以提示词层面的机制实现，因此无需梯度更新即可获得其益处。我们在 Big-Bench Hard（100 个问题）上验证该协议，并在同一冻结主干上以 GSM8K（500 个问题）和 MATH（500 个问题）建立跨领域行为，同时在 Qwen2.5-72B 上进行跨模型复现。所有实验均采用纯推理基准；工具调用多样性组成部分以提示词层面形式验证，环境层面和多智能体扩展则是留待未来工作的设计蓝图。在干净的 BBH 上，该协议并未将准确率提高到 95% Wilson 区间之外；其价值在于成本受限的自我验证，其中 CONFIRMED 提前停止以相同准确率终止了 82—88% 的题目，平均约为每题 2.1 次生成。
items.author_line: Wei Yu, Suxing Liu, Minjie Yu, Jiahao Wang, Zhijian Zheng, Haocheng Deng, Bing Li

items.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. To improve rule following and generalization, we introduce Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP), which separates perception, execution, and rule verification through interpretable reasoning primitives. By disentangling these components, DMP facilitates systematic generalization to more complex and previously unseen rules, while providing transparent intermediate planning traces. Experiments demonstrate that DMP substantially improves rule compliance and planning success compared to end-to-end textual planning baselines. Overall, RuleMaze establishes a principled benchmark for studying grounded and interpretable rule-based spatial planning in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze.
items.summary_zh: RuleMaze 用带自然语言规则的迷宫测试多模态模型的视觉感知、规则解释和受约束规划，并提供可执行验证器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可生成的规则与逻辑表示让规则遵循能够被直接检查，适合观察模型对未见约束的泛化情况。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）结合了语言推理与视觉感知，但其在显式或此前未见规则约束下进行视觉空间规划的能力仍未得到充分研究。该场景要求模型共同理解空间布局、解释自然语言规则，并据此规划有效动作。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 RuleMaze：一个可控基准，其中 MLLM 必须在迷宫中导航，同时遵守复杂度不同的自然语言规则。RuleMaze 通过要求准确感知、规则解释和受约束动作规划，分离出符合规则的空间规划能力。为实现可扩展且系统的规则构造，我们提出 Language-Logic-Function Hybridization，它自动生成自然语言规则，并将其翻译为逻辑表示和可执行验证器，从而免除人工规则工程。为改善规则遵循和泛化，我们提出 Disentangled Multimodal Planning（DMP），通过可解释的推理原语分开感知、执行和规则验证。通过将这些组成部分区分开来，DMP 有助于对更复杂、此前未见规则的系统性泛化，并提供透明的中间规划轨迹。实验表明，与端到端文本规划基线相比，DMP 显著提高了规则遵循和规划成功率。总体而言，RuleMaze 为研究具身且可解释的基于规则的 MLLM 空间规划建立了一个有原则的基准。代码可见于 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze。
items.author_line: Yu Chen, Ting Lei, Yaoyi Li, Jia Cai, Zhecen Wu, Yang Liu

items.title: Uncovering the Limits of Proof Sharing for Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Robustness verification of neural networks is increasingly important, due to their use in many critical domains. In certain scenarios, proof sharing has been shown to accelerate incomplete verification techniques by reusing intermediate-layer abstract states, or templates, across queries. However, questions remain as to the robustness of template-based acceleration across varying network architectures, properties, datasets, and training methods. In this work, we perform a systematic study of the effectiveness of template-based acceleration and its limits. Our study shows that template subsumption rates can vary widely across scenarios. We present a novel metric of jointly stable neurons to explain this variation, showing that in some cases template-based techniques are very unlikely to provide any speedup. Then, we present FastCert, a novel technique for automatically distributing templates across neural network layers to increase performance impact, eschewing templates entirely if they are unlikely to produce a speedup. Across a large set of covering-design based L_0-verification tasks, FastCert achieved an average speedup of 1.13x over an extant template-based reuse technique.
items.summary_zh: 该文系统考察神经网络鲁棒性验证中的证明共享何时有效，并以稳定神经元指标解释模板复用效果的差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: FastCert 会据预期收益在网络层间分配模板或放弃模板，研究在一组 L_0 验证任务上报告了可量化的平均加速。
items.abstract_zh: 由于神经网络被用于许多关键领域，其鲁棒性验证愈发重要。在某些场景中，证明共享已被证明可通过跨查询复用中间层抽象状态或模板来加速不完备验证技术。然而，模板加速在不同网络架构、性质、数据集和训练方法下的稳健性仍有疑问。在这项工作中，我们系统研究模板加速的有效性及其局限。研究显示，模板包含率在不同场景中可能有很大差异。我们提出联合稳定神经元这一新指标来解释这种变化，表明在某些情况下，基于模板的技术很不可能带来任何加速。随后，我们提出 FastCert：一种新技术，能够自动在神经网络层间分配模板以提高性能影响；当模板不太可能带来加速时，该方法会完全不使用模板。在一大组基于覆盖设计的 L_0 验证任务中，FastCert 相对于现有的模板复用技术实现了平均 1.13 倍加速。

items.title: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines: Interpretable Quantum Machine Learning with Commuting Projector Clauses
items.abstract_or_text: Tsetlin Machines (TMs) learn interpretable Boolean clauses using finite-state automata. We introduce the Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine (QL-TM), which replaces Boolean literals with quantum propositions represented by projectors while retaining classical include/exclude automata. Clauses are restricted to commuting measurement contexts and activate through the Born probability of their joint projector. We prove an exact reduction to ordinary Boolean TM clauses in diagonal computational-basis contexts and connect Pauli-projector clauses to stabilizer and syndrome semantics. Controlled experiments on Bell states, phase-flip syndromes, randomized 16-class stabilizer tasks, mixed literal pools, context-budget ablations, and finite-shot noise show that correct non-diagonal contexts recover physically meaningful clauses, while diagonal or wrong contexts lose the relevant phase/syndrome information. The context-budget results closely follow the predicted separability ladder 2^(b-k) as true stabilizer generators are removed. The contribution is a controlled bridge between Tsetlin clause learning and quantum logic, not a claim of quantum advantage.
items.summary_zh: QL-TM 将 Tsetlin Machines 的布尔文字替换为量子投影算符命题，并在可交换测量语境中学习可解释子句。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章给出向普通布尔 TM 子句的精确归约，并以受控任务和噪声实验检验该表示的物理语义。
items.abstract_zh: Tsetlin Machines（TM）使用有限状态自动机学习可解释的布尔子句。我们提出 Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine（QL-TM），它用由投影算符表示的量子命题替换布尔文字，同时保留经典的包含/排除自动机。子句被限制在可交换的测量语境中，并通过其联合投影算符的 Born 概率激活。我们证明，在对角计算基语境中可精确归约为普通布尔 TM 子句，并将 Pauli 投影算符子句与稳定子和综合征语义联系起来。对 Bell 态、相位翻转综合征、随机化的 16 类稳定子任务、混合文字池、语境预算消融和有限采样噪声的受控实验显示，正确的非对角语境能够恢复具有物理意义的子句，而对角语境或错误语境会丢失相关的相位/综合征信息。随着移除真实稳定子生成元，语境预算结果紧密遵循预测的可分离性阶梯 2^(b-k)。该贡献是在 Tsetlin 子句学习与量子逻辑之间建立一座受控桥梁，并未声称具有量子优势。

items.abstract_or_text: Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmaster in StarCraft II, they have driven some of our biggest AI breakthroughs. Our work with SIMA taught agents how to understand 3D worlds, but learning to navigate real human dynamics takes a living, persistent universe. Through our research partnership with @FenrisCreations, we’re exploring how to tackle open challenges in AI: 🔵 Continual learning to acquire new skills without forgetting past knowledge. 🔵 Deep memory systems that store and retrieve information far beyond today’s context windows. 🔵 Long-horizon planning over weeks, months, or years. 🔵 Multi-agent dynamics spanning cooperation, negotiation, economics, and emergent behaviors. Our long-term goal is to use AI to discover entirely new gameplay experiences in partnership with game developers – making games more accessible and personalized – while applying what we've learned to problems in the real world and scientific discovery. items.title: lancedb/lancedb
